My plot is small, only a quarter of a gasha really, and sorghum here in Benshagul Gumuz does reasonably well even without much input because the land still has some fertility. I will try to get some DAP from the cooperative if it arrives in time, but I cannot afford much, and urea is often too expensive for me. I keep a few goats and oxen so I will spread their manure on the plot before planting, and I will use seed I saved from last year's harvest together with some beans intercropped. My wife and children will help with weeding and bird-scaring when the sorghum heads form, and I may call on a few neighbors for the weeding if the rains are heavy.
